title: Employees
localOnly: Controls employee cardless access. Existing physical card permissions remain unchanged.
empty: No employees found. Create an employee or import controller users.
name: Name
importHelp: Controller records are imported every five minutes. Assign credentials to pending accounts. Link records for the same person explicitly; names are never merged automatically.

syncStatus.limited: Legacy import: only users exposed through card records are available
syncStatus.unsupported: User enumeration is not supported by this provider or controller
syncStatus.failed: Import failed. Previous imported permissions were retained.

accountHelp: Use a unique name. This name is also the employee's face-library identity.
passwordHelp: Use at least 12 characters. Leave the password empty when editing to keep it unchanged. A password change signs the employee out.
faceHelp: Upload an image containing exactly one face, or link an existing face. Its label must match the employee's assigned name.
permissionsHelp: Saving creates a local override for this controller. Physical card permissions and time schedules remain unchanged.
linkHelp: Select the employee who will own these controller records. That employee keeps their credentials, face, and local overrides. The source account is retired when it has no remaining records.
deleteHelp: Delete {{name}} and prevent automatic reimport? Existing face-library images and physical controller users will be retained.
